KonvaBase defines hooks such as updateCallback() which KonvaEditor overrides to coordinate toolbar and inspector synchronization (konvaBase.ts:53-55). Subclasses KonvaViewer and KonvaEditor reuse the foundational canvas lifecycle while specializing behavior for passive display versus interactive shape transformation. Baseline inventory carried forward without independent Part 1 re-verification in this stage.
